text: 美股三大指数涨跌不一，标普500指数涨0.23%，道指跌0.97%，纳指涨1.12%。大型科技股方面，超威半导体涨8.66%，英伟达涨5.71%，SpaceX涨5.68%，特斯拉涨1.93%，谷歌A涨1.42%，Meta涨1.02%，微软跌1.10%，苹果跌1.22%。中概股方面，小鹏集团涨3.65%，蔚来涨3.12%，理想汽车涨1.51%，哔哩哔哩涨1.33%，携程涨1.06%，阿里巴巴跌1.32%，拼多多跌1.92%。
text_en: The three major U.S. stock indexes closed mixed, with the S&P 500 up 0.23%, the Dow down 0.97%, and the Nasdaq up 1.12%. Among large technology stocks, Advanced Micro Devices rose 8.66%, Nvidia rose 5.71%, SpaceX rose 5.68%, Tesla rose 1.93%, Google A rose 1.42%, Meta rose 1.02%, Microsoft fell 1.10%, and Apple fell 1.22%. Among Chinese concept stocks, XPeng Group rose 3.65%, NIO rose 3.12%, Li Auto rose 1.51%, Bilibili rose 1.33%, Trip.com rose 1.06%, Alibaba fell 1.32%, and Pinduoduo fell 1.92%.
